findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: anansi_price_changes · Private data: anansi_search, anansi_price_current, anansi_price_changes_recent, anansi_price_changes, anansi_price_advisor · Public sink: anansi_price_changes_recent · Destructive: anansi_price_changes_recent.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: anansi_price_changes · Private data: anansi_search, anansi_price_current, anansi_price_changes_recent, anansi_price_changes, anansi_price_advisor · Public sink: anansi_price_changes_recent · Destructive: anansi_price_changes_recent

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
